shots.description: The player tears down the coast road at full speed with three OCPD interceptors flanking and Juno's tanker ahead, HUD showing 4 wanted stars, cash, minimap and the escort objective.
shots.title: Four-star chase — interceptors flanking, tanker ahead

shots.description: The player on foot among the moored boats at the marina, pedestrians strolling the docks, the gold mission beacon marking Dalia's pickup across the city.
shots.title: On foot at the marina — Opal Coast at golden hour

shots.description: Mission m3 at the start line: the player's car beside a rival, the first teal checkpoint ring glowing ahead, the minimap showing the route through the city.
shots.title: The getaway — teal checkpoints with a rival on your bumper

shots.description: On foot at the end of the pier with three wanted stars, two OCPD interceptors closing in from the shore road, the sea stretching out behind.
shots.title: Cornered on the pier — three stars and nowhere to run
